CustomField.description: API name of the Screen Flow this section shows when Component Type is Flow. The page section editor lists only active flows built from the (Form) Flow Section template, because those carry the inputs and outputs the form exchanges with a flow: the record, its Id and the navigation buttons. Flows built from scratch are not listed, though a value saved earlier still shows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Active flows built from the Form Flow Section template. Select the Screen Flow to embed in this section; it must be Active and created from that template so it exchanges the form's record and navigation data.
CustomField.label: FlowApiName
